intervention: Expected recovery sampling fraction 10%, weighted sampling with replacement

training.sampler_test: 10.263% recovery over 9,997 draws with requested 10%; action chunks remain aligned

limitations: Sampling is now with replacement, unlike the previous uniform shuffled epoch; this is not a perfectly isolated loss-weight ablation.
Nearest-neighbor gripper disagreement is a diagnostic and does not establish causality.

control.sampling: Same weighted replacement sampler, same total draws and update count as 10% candidate; zero probability for recovery samples
control.purpose: Separate continued-training effects from recovery-data contribution

decision: Reject 10% recovery model. Preserve 0% continued-training candidate separately (99/100 official; 489/500 fresh strict versus baseline 487/500). Keep incumbent submission unchanged pending larger independent confirmation.
findings: Nearby-state gripper disagreement exists in both base and recovery demonstrations; not established as sole cause.
Under matched replacement sampling and update budgets, the selected 0% recovery model strongly outperforms the selected 10% model in this experiment.
Lower held-out action MSE did not guarantee higher rollout success.
0% candidate improvement over incumbent is small; one training seed and one fresh test set do not establish robust superiority.
next_step: Confirm the 0% continued-training candidate on larger new paired evaluation before promoting; redesign/filter recovery demonstrations before further mixing.
